name: RWS Amsterdam–Rhine Canal: measured bed and assumed design
description: A 60 × 200 m subset near Utrecht of the Dutch national 1 m bathymetry snapshot for April 2025. Current XYZ values are genuine multibeam-derived raster cell means. The flat reference is hypothetical.
reference_status: Hypothetical flat design at -6.5 m NAP; not an official maintenance profile, earlier survey, or measured sludge underside.

metadata.source_title: Bathymetrie Nederland - binnenwateren 1 mtr. Nederland - april 2025
metadata.survey_date_note: April 2025 is the composite snapshot date; individual source sounding dates are not provided by this raster subset.
metadata.sensor_basis: Official lineage states multibeam soundings; sensor model and per-cell survey details are not given.
metadata.lineage: The national product aggregates measured bed heights from Rijkswaterstaat's Landelijk Opslagsysteem Lodingen. Each 1 square metre height is the mean of all measured points in that cell.
metadata.point_representation: Raster pixel centres carrying measured cell means, not original individual soundings. No synthetic perturbations, invented sediment thickness, reprojection, or vertical transformation were applied.
metadata.uncertainty: No per-cell sounding uncertainty is supplied. The 1 m spacing is not an accuracy claim.
limitations: This demonstrates volume above an assumed design, not observed sludge thickness or accumulation.
The source has already undergone hydrographic processing and cell averaging; this demo does not validate raw sonar corrections or the ECHO reconstruction.
RWS marks these data as unsuitable for navigation.
A TIN through cell centres covers a slightly smaller area than the original pixel-edge footprint. Compare integrations only over the same accepted support and grid.
WCS range-type unit labels can be generic raster defaults; the official dataset metadata explicitly establishes metres NAP.
